claims.text: Introducing a high-entropy ceramic composite into single-phase ZrB2 can reduce the required preparation temperature.
Introducing a high-entropy ceramic composite can maintain adequate strength during lower-temperature manufacture.
Introducing a high-entropy ceramic composite can maintain structural integrity during manufacture and service.
Introducing a high-entropy ceramic composite can improve oxidation durability.
Introducing a high-entropy ceramic composite can prolong service in a liquid plating bath.
The proposed structural mediator is a high-entropy ceramic composite containing multiple principal elements in equal or near-equal proportions.
The presence of a high-entropy ceramic composite increases strength and hardness.
The presence of a high-entropy ceramic composite increases oxidation resistance.
The proposed composite can be prepared below 1700 °C.
The proposed benefits apply during service in a high-temperature liquid plating bath.

The proposed material will outperform both high-temperature-prepared single-phase ZrB2 and prior lower-temperature specimens in strength, structural integrity, oxidation durability, and liquid-bath service life.
